name: EsoLang-Bench
description: EsoLang-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate genuine reasoning in large language models via esoteric programming languages that are unlikely to be memorized. It tests models on five esoteric languages, measuring transferable reasoning skills resistant to data contamination and mimicking human learning through documentation and iterative experimentation.
reputation: A new esoteric-language benchmark that has attracted interest as a contamination-resistant test of genuine reasoning, but it is not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Uses esoteric languages with minimal public data to prevent memorization and better assess reasoning capabilities.
